description: Supervised traffic-classification output vector for the flow-classifier-v1 model family. The class count and ordering are locked for every model in the family (PROJECT.md §9). 'suspicious' is a supervised class, NOT a substitute for anomaly detection — a separate anomaly model produces a novelty score (PROJECT.md §13).

classes.name: brute_force
classes.description: Credential brute force against a service.

classes.name: web_attack
classes.description: Web application attack (injection, traversal, RCE attempt).

classes.name: suspicious
classes.description: Anomalous but unattributed; a supervised catch-all, not an anomaly score.
